app.title: Hister: A private search engine for the pages you visit and the files you keep
app.author: bookofjoe
app.description: Local, private search engine for browsing history and local files, built with Rust and Rust libraries.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `cargo build` to ensure compilation succeeds.
Run `hister search 'test'` against a sample directory and verify results.
Index a known set of files and run a query to check relevance and latency.
Start the HTTP API with `hister server` and send a GET request to `/search` endpoint, verifying JSON response.
Measure index creation time for 10,000 files and compare to baseline.
